caption: The conditional rule that worked in our test: when "Will you attend?" is not Yes, hide "Dietary needs". A plain Show rule did not hide the field beforehand.
The published form on the free plan, with the "Made with Tally" badge bottom right. Before a choice is made, the hidden field still shows.
Our test submission in the Submissions tab, about 3.5 minutes after we started building, with the Download CSV button top right.
File upload is available on the free plan, with a 10 MB size limit per file; unlimited uploads need Tally Pro.
The in-app upgrade screen on monthly billing: Pro at EUR 25 and Business at EUR 79 per month. We stopped here and paid nothing.
